135)chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las:tshe sgrub bsdus pa yang gsang snying po bzhugs:na mo:rang rig lha la skyabs su mchi:rtog gnyis bral bar sems bska

tei:div.tei:p: chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: tshe sgrub bsdus pa yang gsang snying po bzhugs: na mo: rang rig lha la skyabs su mchi: rtog gnyis bral bar sems bskyed do: āḥ gnas lugs ma bcos don gyi lha: o rgyan pad+ma tshe dpag med: dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: mnyam gzhag tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: longs spyod rgyan rdzogs zhi tshul ldan: mtshan dpe rab rdzogs gzi 'od 'bar: gos dkar yum dang gnyis med sbyor: zhabs gnyis skyil krung pad zlar bzhugs: ye shes 'ja' 'od 'khyil pa'i klong: snang la rang bzhin med par gsal: 'khor du tshe bdag rigs lnga dang: tshe yi lha mo'i tshogs kyis bskor: gnas gsum rdo rje'i snying po las: 'od 'phros dbyings bzhugs ye shes lha: spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur: thugs kar nyi zla'i ga'u'i nang: dwangs ma lnga yi 'od thig sbubs: hrīḥdamar mtha' mar sngags kyis bskor: 'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis bsgrubs: rgyal kun gsang gsum byin rlabs dang: snang srid tshe bsod dpal yon kun: lnga ldan 'od kyi rnam pa ru: 136) shangs sgrom nas zhugs gnas lnga dang: thugs srog snying por ro gcig 'dres: 'chi med tshe dpal mchog thob bsam: oṃ a mi dhe wa ā yur+dz+nyā na ma hā puṇ+ye tshe bh+rūm̐ nṛ dza sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: cazhas pa brgya stong khri gsum bzla: 'chi med tshe dbang thob par nges: bden rdzun lag tu longs 'dang gsal: dregs pa rnam gsum gnyer gyis shig: skal ldan bu dang 'phrad par shog: snod min rnams la kha thaṃ rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: zhes pa 'di yang snga 'gyur bstan pa'i gsal sgron rje drung skyabs mgon mchog gi zhal snga nas 'di ltar dgos zhes lha reg dri bral dang*/ bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos rdzas bcas gsung gi dbugs dbyung spyi bor phebs pa ldog ma nus par rten 'brel tsam du/ lcags 'brug zla tshes 25dge bar ri che'i nye 'dabs theg mchog gling nas su kha badz+ra gyis gtan la phab pa'i yi ge pa n-i rang gi nye gnas shākya'i dge btsun shī la badz+ra gyis bris pa'o//
